data_semantics.report_eligible: successful reservation history exists for requested campaign
data_semantics.report_installed: requested voucher leads with installed status, independent of redeemed
data_semantics.report_cost_vnd: redeemed voucher discount + frozen gift cost; not ad spend/revenue
data_semantics.billing_options: period previews include selected accessories and gift checks; no token; refresh main quote before submission

audit_notes.billing_options: Period previews include selected accessory_ids and gift conflict checks, but have no quote token; refresh main quote before submission.
audit_notes.voucher_status_no_benefit: Effective discount is zero and no gift; not eligible for reservation.
audit_notes.target_check: GET /api/v1/pages/{slug}; built-in targets /, /khuyen-mai, /do-toc-do. Server revalidates on link save and resolution.
audit_notes.erased_ledger: Consumed entitlements/cost survive PII erasure anonymously; no exact historical attribution or event funnel.
audit_notes.context_mutations: Serialize POST and DELETE to preserve cookie order; fence rendering by generation.
audit_notes.link_performance: Creator/title/note + anonymous click/form/current-closed performance tracked by dedicated module; see LINK-PERFORMANCE-LUONG-DU-LIEU.md. Prior exact funnels are not fabricated.
